caption: The three firms as they arrive: source exports in, entities and assertions out. Entities can outnumber records because one record can mint two: a customer row is a party and its credit terms, a product row is a product and its stock position, a sale is an order and its line. Relation types in use counts the relation predicates that carry at least one edge. Every record is generated by a seeded script and every figure here is computed from the build, not recorded by hand.
